name: WhatsDesk
description:
WhatsDesk is an unofficial desktop client for WhatsApp Web tailored for Linux. It wraps the WhatsApp web service into a standalone desktop window with system integration.

Features:
- Native desktop notifications for incoming messages and phone calls
- System tray integration with unread message badge count
- Full support for sending text, voice messages, images, documents, and emojis
- Spell checking and configurable zoom scaling for high-DPI displays
- Secure sandboxed environment keeping messaging isolated from regular browsing tabs
